title: OAuthClients
description: A paginated list of OAuth clients.

total.description: The number of items that match the given filters

TrustedPublisher.description:
A binding that allows a service principal (a machine identity such as a
GitHub Actions workflow) to publish to a single content item. A workload
that authenticates as the service principal can upload bundles and deploy
this content, but cannot act on any other content.

service_principal_guid.description: The GUID of the service principal bound to this content item.

name.description: The descriptive name of the service principal.

role.description:
The auth role workloads authenticating as the service principal carry.
Trusted publishers carry only the viewer role; their ability to publish
comes from the per-content grant, not this role.

app_role.description: The content access level granted to the service principal on this item.
